visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) In the interior of a BMW car, a man with short dark hair and a light grey t-shirt is seen from the side, then turns to face the camera. He holds several New Taiwan Dollar bills and looks directly at the lens with an expressive face. The lighting is bright and natural from the car windows. (2) The scene shifts to a drive-through window of a McDonald's. A staff member wearing a purple mask and a cap hands a brown paper bag and a tray with cups to the man through the car window. (3) A young girl with glasses and a black t-shirt is seen sitting in the car, holding the large McDonald's paper bag and looking at the camera excitedly. (4) The scene transitions to an indoor living room. The man and the girl are seated at a table. In front of them are three different sizes of McDonald's fries in red packaging and a pink digital scale with a white bowl on it. The man pours the small fries into the bowl to weigh them. (5) The man pours the medium fries into the bowl, while the girl is seen eating a hard-boiled egg. The background shows a modern living room with a TV and a curtained window. (6) The man pours the large fries into the bowl. He holds the large red fry carton and looks at the scale. (7) The man holds up a piece of white paper with handwritten calculations and data comparing the weights and prices of the different fry sizes. He and the girl look at the camera and explain their findings.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The video starts in a modern car interior with a sunroof. It moves to a McDonald's drive-through window. Most of the video takes place in a well-lit living room with a large screen, curtains, and a dining table.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Fast-paced, cheerful synthesizer background music begins. A male voice speaks enthusiastically and clearly about a McDonald's experiment, with a slight echo as if in a car. (2) A plastic rustling sound occurs as the man receives the food bag. The BGM maintains a steady, energetic beat. (3) Scene transition to indoors; the background ambience is clean room tone. The man's voice is joined by a young girl's voice, who speaks with a high-pitched, clear tone. (4) Distinct thudding sounds of fries being poured into a plastic bowl are audible. Each pouring action is synchronized with the man's explanation of the weight being measured. (5) Paper rustling occurs as the man holds up the calculation sheet. The BGM swells slightly as they conclude the findings. The man and girl speak together in a playful, informative tone.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Purchase -> Experiment/Weighing -> Data Comparison -> Conclusion/Advice
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to provide a practical comparison of McDonald's French fries sizes (small, medium, and large) to determine which offers the best value for money per gram. It uses a scientific weighing approach to debunk popular 'urban legends' about fry quantities, ultimately advising viewers that the small size is the most cost-effective.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video focuses entirely on evaluating and testing products from a specific brand (McDonald's), showing the packaging and purchasing process prominently.
